mods.name: Create: Item Sink
mods.description:
A configurable Create addon for Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge that converts unwanted items into currency.
Customize prices, currency items, processing times, and FE costs in item_sink-common.toml.

releases.notes:
Create: Item Sink **1.0.0** for **Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.251+ / Java 21**. Requires **Create 6.0.x**.

## Features

- Convert unwanted items into configurable currency payouts using FE.
- Match prices by item IDs, tags, phrases, wildcards, or whole mods.
- Customize currencies, payout amounts, processing times, FE costs, exclusions, and fallback prices.
- Automate input and output with Create belts and funnels.
- Hold **W** over the sink for its Ponder tutorial. JEI shows a compact currency overview.

## Install

Place **create_item_sink-neoforge-1.21.1-1.0.0.jar** in your client and server `mods` folders alongside Create. Replace the previous Item Sink JAR and keep `config/item_sink-common.toml`.

Numismatics, JEI, and Create Crafts & Additions are optional. Default payouts use Numismatics coins; without it, configure another installed currency item such as `minecraft:emerald`.

[Configuration guide](https://github.com/IWasCool/create-item-sink/blob/main/CONFIGURATION.md) | [Source](https://github.com/IWasCool/create-item-sink)
